definitions.explanation: A system where people who arrive or apply first are given priority.

examples.japanese: ⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{先着順|せんちゃくじゅん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Tickets will be sold on a first-come, first-served basis.

examples.japanese: {先着順|せんちゃくじゅん}100⟦{名|めい}→〜名：04015_mei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The first 100 people will receive a gift.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{先着順|せんちゃくじゅん}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦お→お：03097_o⟧⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。
examples.english: Reservations are first-come, first-served, so please hurry.

examples.japanese: {先着順|せんちゃくじゅん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{整理券|せいりけん}→整理券：08288_seiriken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配|くば}っている→配る：03921_kubaru⟧。
examples.english: They're distributing numbered tickets on a first-come, first-served basis.

examples.japanese: {先着順|せんちゃくじゅん}30⟦{名|めい}→〜名：04015_mei⟧⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{終|お}わっていた→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: There was a special menu limited to the first 30 customers, but it was already sold out when I got there.

notes:
{先着順|せんちゃくじゅん} means places are given out in order of arrival or application, until they run out. It is one of the two standard ways Japanese notices ration something limited.

USAGE:
- The method takes ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: {先着順|せんちゃくじゅん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧ (sold first-come, first-served)
- ⟦{先着|せんちゃく}→先着：08320_senchaku⟧ without ⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧ heads a number: ⟦{先着|せんちゃく}→先着：08320_senchaku⟧100⟦{名|めい}→〜名：04015_mei⟧ (the first 100 people)
- Shop and event notices often add ⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧ for politeness: ⟦{先着|せんちゃく}→先着：08320_senchaku⟧50⟦{名|めい}→〜名：04015_mei⟧⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{抽選|ちゅうせん}→抽選：07054_chuusen⟧ (lottery) is the alternative, and which one applies decides how you should behave: {先着順|せんちゃくじゅん} rewards arriving or applying early, ⟦{抽選|ちゅうせん}→抽選：07054_chuusen⟧ makes speed irrelevant. ⟦{予約制|よやくせい}→予約制：07058_yoyakusei⟧ (by reservation) is a third arrangement, where a booking rather than a queue secures the place.
